messages.subject: Creating CDF for Dm_tiling2_MR_v01.bpmap
parts:
Dear list,
I have some new Drosophila Tiling 2.0R data to have a look at, so i'm trying to convert the bpmap from Affymetrix to CDF, following the instructions at: http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/creating-cdf-files-from-bpmap-files-tiling-arrays

I'm getting a failure when writing the CDF header, and i'm also concerned about the number of probes that are being excluded, especially those mapping to various Drosophila chromosomes.
Error in .initializeCdf(con = con, nRows = cdfHeader$nrows, nCols = cdfHeader$ncols,  : 
  Number of elements in argument 'unitLengths' does not match 'nUnits'

can anyone please help?

I wonder if it could be a versioning issue, since the standard 
source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbGet("aroma.affymetrix")
wouldn't install aroma.core (on OSX), so I downloaded the latest source versions of aroma.light, aroma.core, aroma.affymetrix, R.utils, R.filesets, R.oo (essentially anything that was required when R CMD INSTALL aroma.affymetrix_1.3.0.tar.gz failed) from braju.com

cheers,
Mark
-----------------------------------------------------
Mark Cowley, PhD

Peter Wills Bioinformatics Centre
Garvan Institute of Medical Research, Sydney, Australia
-----------------------------------------------------

Heya Mark,

You need to specify the groupName to bpmapCluster2Cdf - the reason it
is skipping everything is because it is looking for human probes
add groupName="Dm" and it should work

Cheers,
Aaron

Thanks Aaron.

In addition, you might also want to adjust a few other parameters. I
see you have a handle on 'rows' and 'cols'. For starters, you can see
all the arguments from:

> source("http://129.94.136.7/file_dump/mark/bpmapCluster2Cdf.R")
> args(bpmapCluster2Cdf)
function (filename, cdfName, nProbes = 30, gapDist = 3000, rows = NULL,
groupName = "Hs", cols = NULL, field = "fullname", verbose = 10,
stringRemove = "Hs:Sun.Nov.19.17:25:02.2006;")

For yours, presumably you want to set stringRemove="Dm:BDGPv5;" ... to
get aesthetically pleasing (?) unit names.

The 'nProbes' argument requires each "cluster" (= probeset = unit) to
have at least 30 probes, maybe you want to change this? ... the
'gapDist' argument determines the point at which (based on the
$startpos element) to break sets of probes into separate units. For
Hs_PromPR, this makes different promoters have different units.
Consider this for your array.
